g.text: NOTEBOOKLM-PY ASYNC HTTPX CLIENT & ORACLE ARCHITECTURE
Layered CLI Ingress, High-Concurrency Connection Pooling, and Resilient Google Session Persistence
ASYNC HTTPX CLIENT POOL & TOKEN ROTATION PLANE
GOOGLE CLOUD RPC & SESSION PERSISTENCE PLANE
- Auto-Auth Daemon: Detects expired cookies and re-authenticates prior to 3600s TTL
- DPAPI Encrypted Store: Session tokens secured locally via Windows DPAPI hardware encryption
- Zero Token Loss: Local SQLite cache stores query responses for 7-day instant recall
- Sliding Window Bucket: Throttles queries to 30 req/min to prevent Google 429 rate limits
- Persistent HTTP/2 Pool: AsyncClient maintains 100 keep-alive sockets with automated health checks
- Concurrency Semaphores: Max 8 parallel query worker coroutines per notebook
